Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_EnableVanillaBatte: Replace vanilla battery loot with sized batteries
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_ToolAssistedReplac: Fraction removed from the combined removal and installation time when a device requires an access tool. Represents keeping its battery compartment open. Default: 10%%.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_BatteryCapacityMul: Applied when battery profiles are registered. Existing installed battery charge remains clamped safely.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_UVConsumptionMulti: Multiplies B47ANCE'd Power loads whose registered load item identifies UV output.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_EnableVanillaBatte: Converts newly generated Base.Battery loot in-place. The legacy item remains registered for old saves and vanilla device compatibility.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_LootWeightAAA_tool: Relative chance among converted vanilla batteries. Set every battery weight to zero to fall back to AA.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_DigitalWatchDrainP: Digital-watch coin-cell drain per game minute
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_SolarMilitaryWatch: Solar military-watch chance in military loot
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_BatteryPackAssembl: Fraction of the consumed cells' remaining energy retained by a taped battery pack.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_DigitalWatchDrainP: Absolute coin-cell capacity consumed per game minute. Zero disables watch drain.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_CoinCellLootChance: Independent chance applied when eligible electronics containers are generated.
Sandbox_B47ANCEDPower_SolarMilitaryWatch: Independent rare chance applied to eligible military loot contexts.
